title: Octopuses Really Do Punch Fish, and It Was Filmed

scenes.text: Octopuses punch fish. Scientists filmed it.
In the Red Sea, octopuses hunt in teams with groupers and goatfish.
When a fish cheats the group, the octopus strikes with one arm in an explosive jab.
The punch pushes the fish to the edge of the group, or out of it completely.
Scientists think it keeps the hunting team working together.

description:
